dct_description_sm: The objectives of this workshop-based project were in the first year: (1) to develop a risk assessment workshop in order to build capacity in Aboriginal and Northern community members to undertake climate change risk assessments within their communities; and (2) to build capacity within the Centre for Indigenous Environmental Resources (CIER) regarding community-based, climate change risk assessment and climate change adaptation.   In the second year, the project had four objective: (1) to deliver a Climate Change Risk Management Workshop for Aboriginal and northern communities in order to inform and build capacity for adaptation; (2) to build capacity of workshop participants from Aboriginal and Northern communities and territorial governments to undertake and support climate change risk management activities within communities; (3) to coordinate, host and deliver a 3.5 day risk management workshop; and (4) to build capacity within CIER to develop community-based climate change risk management and climate change adaptation projects.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Adaptation
dct_title_s: Climate Change Risk Management Workshop Development and Delivery
